edges.reason: constructor uses msg.sender as creator, initial flag holder and full-supply recipient.
transfer forwards _msgSender() as the debited sender.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() both as spender and for allowance decrement.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
onlyOwner guard on SetStakingReward is evaluated against _msgSender() and the _ownr fallback address.
onlyOwner guard on BringFreedom compares _msgSender() to stored owner/ownr.
onlyOwner guard on CreateAFarm, which can mint arbitrary supply.
onlyOwner guard on CheckAPY, which can rewrite transfer gating flags for any address.
msg.sender is packed into the keccak256 entropy of randomly(), making the result caller-derivable.
block.timestamp (now) is used as randomness input in randomly(), a classic timestamp dependency.
randomly() output is the predictable value powering the unsafe randomness operation used for transfer gating.
_transfer invokes randomly() to decide the beast[recipient] flag.
Predictable randomness result controls token transfer success and recipient flag mutation.
randomly() increments the labradudel counter with an unchecked ++ operation.
constructor stores msg.sender into creator.
constructor initialises james = true.
constructor initialises alpaca = true.
constructor sets _totalSupply = 500000000000000.
constructor sets _trns = _totalSupply for the initial Transfer event.
constructor computes chTx = _totalSupply / 2200 with plain division.
constructor sets conquist = _totalSupply.
constructor computes bowling = chTx * 30 without SafeMath overflow checks.
constructor sets marbel[msg.sender] = true granting transfer privileges.
constructor credits the entire supply to msg.sender's balance.
constructor initialises utah = false.
SetStakingReward lets the owner arbitrarily overwrite the conquist transfer cap.
BringFreedom overwrites conquist with chTx/2400 with no bounds.
BringFreedom turns utah on, arming the require(false) transfer trap.
CreateAFarm (onlyOwner) calls _mint, allowing unlimited supply inflation.
CheckAPY rewrites marbel flags for an arbitrary address.
CheckAPY rewrites beast flags, which also controls the allowance override constant.
CheckAPY rewrites aunt flags that can force transfers to revert.
CheckAPY toggles the global utah flag.
transfer delegates all logic to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom decrements the allowance through _approve.
approve writes allowance via _approve.
increasealowance writes the new allowance via _approve.
decreaseallowance writes the reduced allowance via _approve.
_burnFrom destroys tokens via _burn.
_burnFrom reduces the caller allowance via _approve.
_transfer debits sender and credits recipient balances using SafeMath sub/add.
_approve stores the resulting allowance into _allowances.
_mint increases _totalSupply with SafeMath.add and no cap check.
_mint credits the beneficiary balance.
_burn debits the target balance with SafeMath.sub.
_burn reduces _totalSupply with SafeMath.sub.
_transfer silently rewrites james, utah, marbel, beast and aunt flags while moving tokens.
_approve silently rewrites alpaca, marbel, beast and aunt flags for the creator path.
flag manipulation writes the james one-shot toggle.
flag manipulation writes the utah global switch.
flag manipulation writes marbel permissions.
flag manipulation writes beast permissions.
flag manipulation writes aunt permissions.
_transfer can unconditionally require(false), censoring transfers based on flag state.
_approve replaces the requested allowance with 98423442 whenever beast[owner] is set.
The overridden allowance constant is persisted into _allowances.
